name: chaostoclarity
description: Claude skills for founders and operators from Chaos to Clarity.

plugins.name: cortex
plugins.description: Cortex: the context layer your AI reads first. A Map, catalogs, and records for your people, initiatives, decisions, and strategy, in Notion, Obsidian, or Google Drive. Lives in chaostoclarity/Cortex.

plugins.name: cortex-gnome
plugins.description: Cortex Gnome: the overnight worker. Runs nightly on your context and task tools, builds ship-ready work, logs it, sends a brief, and learns from your feedback. Starts reined in. Lives in chaostoclarity/Cortex.

plugins.name: founder-os
plugins.description: Founder Operating System: plan Monday, brief each morning, reflect Friday. Weekly goals, tasks, reflections, and commitments that run on your Cortex.

plugins.name: recap
plugins.description: Meeting Recap: every meeting becomes done work. A branded recap email, your to-dos with time booked, follow-ups drafted, agreed meetings booked, small tasks done, and context saved to your Cortex.

plugins.name: content-engine
plugins.description: Content Engine: every Monday, last week's meetings become one original framework, a newsletter issue, and a LinkedIn post in your voice, with every story kept confidential.

plugins.name: handwritten-notes
plugins.description: Photograph a page of notes. Checkbox items become tasks with time booked on your calendar; everything else is filed as notes.

plugins.name: investor-update
plugins.description: Investor Update: your monthly update drafted from your Cortex. Metrics with deltas, highlights, lowlights, what you promised last time, and specific asks. Always a draft, never sent for you.

plugins.name: customer-signal
plugins.description: Customer Signal: every customer and prospect call becomes evidence. Pains, requests, objections, churn risks, and praise, counted across accounts in your Cortex, with a weekly brief and close-the-loop notes.

plugins.name: one-on-ones
plugins.description: One-on-Ones: prep and debrief every 1:1 from your Cortex. What each report owes you, what you owe them, recurring themes, and a health flag per person, with a monthly team review.

plugins.name: c2c-coach
plugins.description: The Chaos to Clarity AI Coach: all 30 leadership exercises for founders behind one front door. Describe a problem in one sentence and get coached through the right tool.

plugins.name: c2c-coach-focus
plugins.description: Focus and Decisions: nine coaching exercises for founder focus and hard calls. Find the one priority, break a bottleneck, reset when anxious, and decide what you keep circling.

plugins.name: c2c-coach-people
plugins.description: Leading People: six coaching exercises for managing a team. Name what you tolerate, have the hard conversation, delegate so work comes back right, and hire executives well.

plugins.name: c2c-coach-cofounder
plugins.description: Co-Founder and Board: three coaching exercises for the power relationships. Settle CEO and CTO decision rights, break a looping co-founder fight, and reset a tense board.

plugins.name: c2c-coach-scale
plugins.description: Org and Scaling: six coaching exercises for building a company that scales. An operating rhythm, clean team ownership, a scorecard someone owns, and what breaks as you grow.

plugins.name: c2c-coach-growth
plugins.description: Growth Plays: four coaching exercises for growth. Find what customers actually feel, build pull instead of buying it, validate a new market, and design a moment that gets you noticed.

plugins.name: c2c-coach-facilitator
plugins.description: Facilitator Kit: run a founder hot seat for a peer group, advisors, or exec team, and team retros that end in action. Prep, run of show, scripts for hard moments, and follow-up.

plugins.name: above-the-chaos
plugins.description: Above the Chaos: nine Stoic leadership exercises for founders, from the book by Eric Weiss. Control, obstacles, emotion, virtue, culture, and your own leadership philosophy.

plugins.name: c2c-life-coach
plugins.description: Life Coach: a daily check-in and a weekly session for life outside work. Score six areas, tie each score to the habits behind it, and coach from proven books. Runs on its own, with or without a Cortex.

plugins.name: growth-by-design
plugins.description: Growth by Design: 35 product-market fit exercises from the book by Eric Weiss. Score your ten PMF pillars, diagnose what's capping growth, and get coached through the canvas that fixes it.

plugins.name: c2c-council
plugins.description: Chaos to Clarity Council: run any plan, PRD, pricing change, or launch past your department heads. Each seat scores it in private, a CEO makes the call, and you get the revised version.

plugins.name: voice
plugins.description: Voice Rewrite: turn samples of your writing into your own voice skill. It writes and rewrites anything so it sounds like you, avoids the habits that read as AI, and learns from every edit you make.
